interpretation.plain_speak: Turning the warning threshold up cuts false alarms, but it also throws away most real failures. Precision tops out around 40.7% while recall falls to 29.6%. A single cutoff cannot turn the current score into a safe maintenance trigger.
interpretation.north_star_question: Rules out the simplest trigger design and redirects B toward measuring the score's intrinsic discrimination before adding new native signals.
interpretation.next_stage: on a fresh held-out phase, measure threshold-free discrimination of rank-plus-temporal risk versus rank-only risk using AUROC/AUPRC and enrichment, without intervention
